name.en: Yilan branch of the Central Cross-Island Highway

tagline.en: Up the Lanyang valley from Qilan over the Siyuan pass, the watershed at 1,948 m, to Wuling and Lishan, built by veterans with the Central Cross-Island Highway and now the farm road of the high orchards
tagline.zh: 自栖兰沿兰阳溪谷上行，翻越海拔 1,948 米的分水岭思源垭口，至武陵与梨山；与中横同期由退除役官兵开辟，如今是高山果园与菜园的产业道路

start.en: Baitao bridge at Qilan, Datong, Yilan, at 330 m, where it leaves Provincial Highway 7
start.zh: 宜兰县大同乡栖兰百韬桥，海拔 330 米，自台 7 线分出

end.en: Lishan, Heping, Taichung, at 1,707 m, on Provincial Highway 8
end.zh: 台中市和平区梨山，海拔 1,707 米，衔接台 8 线

en: Provincial Highway 7A runs 73.988 km from the Baitao bridge at Qilan, where Highway 7 turns north over the range to Taoyuan, up the Lanyang river through Tuchang, the turning for Taipingshan, Mao'an, Sijisan and Nanshan. It crosses the Siyuan pass at 1,948 m, about 47.8 km, which is both the Yilan–Taichung boundary and the watershed between the Lanyang and Dajia rivers, then drops past the turning for Wuling farm at about 53.3 km and through Huanshan to Lishan.

It is the second-longest provincial spur after Highway 19A. It carried timber from the Qilan forests of red cypress and hinoki, and is the farm road for the high-altitude vegetables of Nanshan and Sijisan and the fruit of Lishan. Many of its bridges are named after historical figures, war heroes and generals, and after the engineers who died building it.
zh: 台 7 甲线全长 73.988 公里，自栖兰百韬桥（台 7 线在此北转翻山往桃园）沿兰阳溪上行，经土场（太平山岔路）、茂安、四季、南山，于约 47.8 公里处越过海拔 1,948 米的思源垭口——宜兰与台中的界线，也是兰阳溪与大甲溪的分水岭——再下行经约 53.3 公里的武陵农场岔路、环山，抵达梨山。
它是仅次于台 19 甲线的第二长省道支线。它曾用于运输栖兰林区的红桧、扁柏，也是南山、四季高冷蔬菜与梨山水果的产业道路。沿线许多桥梁以历史人物、抗战英雄、将领及殉职筑路人员命名。

en: The line follows a Japanese police road over the Piyanan saddle. The post-war road was first planned from Taichung to Luodong and, before 1956, redirected to Yilan city as the Yilan branch of the Central Cross-Island Highway. By the directorate's Fourth District anniversary book, work began in November 1955 and finished in March 1959, mostly as a gravel road; the branch was then 111.6 km from Yilan to Lishan, and was maintained from 9 May 1960 by the district's Dulishan section.

It was built largely by retired servicemen, and it cost lives. A site engineer died on the works on 21 June 1957; a memorial to him stands on Highway 7 at Songluo. In 1958 Typhoon Winnie brought floods that killed workers of the branch; their memorial stands at about 30 km, at Nanshan. The stone pavilion at the Siyuan pass, put up in 1960, is inscribed with the proverb to remember the source when drinking water.

When the Northern Cross-Island Highway opened in 1966, the Yilan–Qilan end was joined to it, and the rest of the branch became 7A; the two numbers were finally sorted out in 1976. After the earthquake of 21 September 1999 closed Highway 8 west of Lishan, 7A became the only road into Lishan and Wuling from the north.
zh: 本线大致沿日治时期的埤亚南越岭警备道而行。战后最初规划自台中至罗东，1956 年前改为通往宜兰市，即中横宜兰支线。据公路总局第四区养护工程处周年纪念专刊，工程于民国 44 年（1955 年）11 月开工，48 年（1959 年）3 月完工，大部分为碎石路面；支线当时自宜兰至梨山长 111.6 公里，1960 年 5 月 9 日起由该处独立山工务段养护。
支线主要由退除役官兵开辟，付出了生命代价。工程员罗裕于 1957 年 6 月 21 日殉职，纪念碑在台 7 线松罗附近。1958 年温妮台风带来山洪，参与支线工程的人员走避不及而殉职，纪念碑位于台 7 甲线约 30 公里的南山村。思源垭口的石亭建于 1960 年，题有“饮水思源”。
1966 年北部横贯公路通车后，宜兰至栖兰段并入北横，支线其余路段成为台 7 甲线；两线编号于 1976 年最终调整完成。1999 年 9 月 21 日地震使台 8 线梨山以西中断后，台 7 甲线成为北面进出梨山、武陵的唯一道路。

en: The upper valley is landslide country. The hairpin at about 41.7 km collapsed in Typhoon Krosa in 2007, Sinlaku and Jangmi in 2008 and Nesat in 2011, and in 2011–12 the road was pulled back about 80 m into the hill. Typhoon Saola cut the road on 2 August 2012 until 10 August. In July 2024 Typhoon Gaemi brought down a slope at about 26 km and left Lishan cut off, and later that year Typhoon Kong-rey closed it between 45 and 52 km, after which it was opened to one lane.

Bridges have been rebuilt to clear the floods. The Zeqian bridge at about 24.7 km was replaced by a single 65 m span, opened on 18 May 2010. The Jiayuan bridge at about 3.5 km, whose southbound span dated from 1959, was rebuilt at 330 m with 100 m spans for NT$277 million and opened on 7 August 2021; the directorate called it its first bridge designed with building information modelling.
zh: 上游河谷是崩塌频繁的地区。约 41.7 公里处的回头弯在 2007 年柯罗莎台风、2008 年辛乐克与蔷蜜台风、2011 年纳莎台风中屡次崩塌，2011 年至 2012 年将路线向山侧内移约 80 米。2012 年 8 月 2 日苏拉台风使本线中断，至 8 月 10 日才恢复。2024 年 7 月凯米台风造成约 26 公里处边坡坍方，梨山对外交通中断；同年稍后康芮台风使 45 至 52 公里中断，其后单线通行。
为避开洪水，桥梁陆续改建。约 24.7 公里的泽仟桥改为单跨 65 米，2010 年 5 月 18 日通车。约 3.5 公里的家源桥，其南下线桥建于 1959 年，改建为长 330 米、跨距 100 米的新桥，经费 2.77 亿元，2021 年 8 月 7 日通车；公路总局称这是该局第一座以建筑信息模型（BIM）设计的桥梁。

en: Speed limits are 15 to 40 km/h. The road is narrow above Nanshan and climbs to the Siyuan pass; in cold spells the Highway Bureau applies snow and ice controls between Nanshan and Shengguang. From Qilan, Highway 7 goes north over the range to Taoyuan; from Lishan, Highway 8 runs east to Dayuling and Hehuanshan.
zh: 全线限速每小时 15 至 40 公里。南山以上路窄，爬升至思源垭口；寒流期间，公路局在南山至胜光间实施降雪、结冰管制。自栖兰可经台 7 线北行翻山至桃园；自梨山可经台 8 线东行至大禹岭与合欢山。

why.en: No separate cost for the Yilan branch has been found. It was built as part of the Central Cross-Island Highway, whose total the directorate's Fourth District anniversary book gives as over NT$430 million in money of the day; the Central Cross-Island dossier gives NT$494.56 million from another source.
why.zh: 未查到宜兰支线的单独造价。它是中横公路工程的一部分；公路总局第四区养护工程处周年纪念专刊称中横公路总工程费 4.3 亿余元（当年币值），本图集中横公路条目则依另一来源记为 4.9456 亿元。

why.en: Funded with the Central Cross-Island Highway, which drew on United States aid; no breakdown for the branch has been found.
why.zh: 随中横公路工程出资，中横公路曾动用美援；未查到本支线的出资分配。

value.en: 73.988 km; the branch was 111.6 km from Yilan to Lishan before the Yilan–Qilan end was joined to the Northern Cross-Island Highway
value.zh: 73.988 公里；宜兰至栖兰段并入北横之前，支线自宜兰至梨山长 111.6 公里

figures.source: Directorate General of Highways route list, as cited in Chinese Wikipedia, 台7線; DGH Fourth District Maintenance Office seventieth-anniversary book (2019)

value.en: 1,948 m, at about 47.8 km; Lanyang–Dajia watershed
value.zh: 海拔 1,948 米，约 47.8 公里处；兰阳溪与大甲溪分水岭

figures.source: As cited in Chinese Wikipedia, 台7線

value.en: NT$277 million; 330 m, 100 m spans; opened 7 August 2021

figures.source: yam news, August 2021, reporting the Directorate General of Highways

timeline.en: Work begins on the Yilan branch in November.
A site engineer dies on the works on 21 June.
timeline.zh: 6 月 21 日，工程员罗裕殉职。

timeline.en: Floods in Typhoon Winnie kill workers on the branch.
timeline.zh: 温妮台风山洪，支线工程人员殉职。

timeline.en: The branch is finished in March, mostly as a gravel road.
timeline.zh: 3 月，支线完工，大部分为碎石路面。

timeline.en: Maintenance passes to the Dulishan section on 9 May; the Siyuan pavilion is built.
timeline.zh: 5 月 9 日起由独立山工务段养护；思源石亭建成。

timeline.en: The Northern Cross-Island Highway opens and takes over the Yilan–Qilan end.
timeline.zh: 北部横贯公路通车，宜兰至栖兰段并入北横。

timeline.en: After the 21 September earthquake, 7A is the only road into Lishan from the north.
timeline.zh: 9 月 21 日地震后，台 7 甲线成为北面进出梨山的唯一道路。

timeline.en: The rebuilt Zeqian bridge opens on 18 May.
timeline.zh: 5 月 18 日，改建后的泽仟桥通车。

timeline.en: The 41.7 km hairpin realignment is finished; Typhoon Saola closes the road on 2–10 August.
timeline.zh: 41.7 公里回头弯改线完成；8 月 2 日至 10 日，苏拉台风使本线中断。

timeline.en: The rebuilt Jiayuan bridge opens on 7 August.
timeline.zh: 8 月 7 日，改建后的家源桥通车。

timeline.en: Typhoons Gaemi and Kong-rey cut the road; Lishan is isolated in July.
timeline.zh: 凯米、康芮台风使本线中断；7 月梨山对外交通一度中断。
